Did you know that the Toronto Raptors technically won the 1996 NBA Draft Lottery (where Allen Iverson went #1)?

BUT... as part of their expansion agreement they signed when they entered the league in 1995 (alongside Vancouver), they weren't allowed any #1 picks until 1999. So they picked 2nd.
